reason: Not refuted as a pre-built, conditional file, but the slot rule has to be fixed. FEASIBILITY is fine. exp79a and exp85a use disjoint probe.json keys (CI: COORDINJECT_ENABLE 1 and ALPHA 0.5. Knobs: ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 and READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94), so their union builds cleanly. Coord-inject is a post-CSV cell with its own refiner models (tools/coordinject_patch.py). It is fail-soft: on 'COORDINJECT FAILED' submission.csv is left exactly as it was. It has a 37,800 s deadline and does not read READMIT, so a topology-identical gate against the exp85a dummy (122,328 / 118,137 / 85) is sound. CI dummies ran 1,712-1,882 s (exp79a, exp83a/b), so the 2,100 s gate is realistic. The knobs add about 0 s (exp85a 1,388 s solo), so hidden L stays about 9.6-10.7 h against the 12 h limit. VALUE is conditional and small. The stack is exactly what W4 AMEND 2 (1) already pre-registers as FULL (BASE + every '+' lever not yet scored) when both the CI lever and the knobs read '+'. Building it now follows the 743929 'build during the re-run' process and costs about 30 min of GPU; it is not a new hypothesis. Three problems in the finding. (1) The slot rule 'disp(50) >= 0.956' counts a TIE with exp70g (0.956) as a pass. That stacks a '0'/'?' lever, against the FULL definition and the rule 'never stack an unread lever' (W2 v4 (2)). If 48 is '+' and 50 ties, FULL is exp79a, which is already scored, so exp87a is not warranted. (2) Timing: 28 Sep has 1 submit left (CONTEXT 05:03Z), held for W2b at 12:00Z. Probe 50 reads about 12:30-13:00Z, so the rule cannot be met at 12:00Z. After 02:00Z 29 Sep no CI file is allowed. The real slots are W4 29 Sep 00:06Z or 00:46Z (read about 09:40-10:45Z, before the 12:00Z proposal), or W2b only if W2b is held until 50 reads. (3) The branch 'if 47 or 49 reads above 45, use exp83a/b + the knobs' points at files that do not exist: exp86a/b carry the knobs WITHOUT CI. It would need new builds. The 'JT full recipe' framing is not supported. R24-PP-1 itself concludes that JT's stage is his private code, and nothing shows it is coord-inject, so the EV of +0.0005 to +0.001 is an additivity guess. CI files stay public-only under letter (b), and their non-CI twin (exp85a) is already scored, so exp87a cannot change the finals pool without a user re-tick. Not a closed line: CI (probe 48) and the knobs (probe 50) are both unread.
fix: Build exp87a now as the exp79a keys + ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94 (PATCHES divinsert+lowrefine+coordinject+safetail). Diff-check that it differs from exp79a only by those two cell-0 lines and from exp85a only by the coordinject cell and keys. Push the dummy when a lane frees. The gate as proposed is: validate ok; 0 Traceback/FAILED/DEADLINE:/FALLING BACK; COORDINJECT 4/4 with about 91.5% of rows moved; the 7 topology columns identical to the exp85a dummy CSV ce8164a8202f (122,328 / 118,137 / 85); integer-coordinate change 0.60-0.69; runtime <= 2,100 s. Replace the slot rule, pre-registered before 48 or 50 reads: submit exp87a only if (a) 48 codes CI '+' under READ TABLE v3 with CI-RAN dL >= 1.2 h and L_hi <= 10.2 h, AND (b) 50 codes '+' against exp70g, meaning disp >= 0.957 or a ladder-watch sub-rounding UP (P5/U4). A 0.956 tie is '0' and gives no exp87a. Slot: W4 29 Sep 00:06Z (CI slot, FULL item 1). Use W2b only if W2b is deliberately held until 50 has read. If 48 is '+' and 50 is not, W4 FULL = exp79a (already scored), so there is nothing to submit. If 47 or 49 becomes BASE, the equivalents are new builds exp83a/b + the knobs (call them exp87b/c), dummied only after that read. Never submit a CI file after 02:00Z 29 Sep. The public-only CI caveat applies to any display.
realistic_gain: It fires only if both pending levers read '+' (joint probability maybe 10-20% given how many 0.956 ties we have seen). If it fires: +0.000 to +0.001 public over max(disp48, disp50), assuming additivity, which is unproven. Private: unknown, the CI coordinate shift is lab in-sample. Finals: none without a user re-tick (CI is public-only; the non-CI twin exp85a is already scored). Cost: one ~30 min CI dummy and, conditionally, one W4 slot.
